verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party scheduler, cron trigger, or recurring-job feature for Pods, Serverless, or Clusters. The REST API, CLI, and MCP servers are only building blocks an external scheduler could call. Batch Inference and multi-node jobs are one-off workloads, not recurring schedules, and Auto-pay is a billing feature, not job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
